title: What do library 3D printers and buses have in common?
author: Ian Anstice / The Library Campaign

editorial.text: 3D printers look to be the same as buses: you wait for one for ages then two come at once. Dundee have let me know that they had their machine set up last Tuesday while Exeter, tardy things, only opened theirs up to the public on Thursday. The Scottish library service is using theirs in quite a novel way too: to print out characters which are then used in story-telling sessions for those with additional needs. It will also be used for printing items for reminiscence packs. Genius.
